title: Audit of c15's nematic fuel-cell rods (SIBD, beyond diffusion): S, I, D replicate on fresh seeds and at 1.5x resolution, but the working ring is made by the bath: the bath makes 73-78% of the surfactant, and with a rod-only source the ring stays at 0.19 (gate midpoint 0.45), does not gate, and core fuel and division fall to the no-ring level, so B is by construction
summary: Construction: the surfactant source is ks (1+phi)/2, so the chemostat bath (phi ~ -0.7) makes surfactant everywhere, and a drift up grad(1-phi^2) collects it at the interface; the fuel is made by the rods; division and nucleation are emergent. On fresh seeds 5 and 6 the unchanged world replicates (100% ringed, core fuel 0.54-0.55, 13 and 12 persistent splits, gen 2-3), and the bath makes 73% and 78% of all surfactant (sshare.py). The deciding control, a source restricted to the bodies (world_srcin.py, ks clip(phi,0,1)), still gives a ring (rim/core 2.5-2.6, 98-99% of bodies) but its band level is 0.185-0.189 against 0.63 in the claimed world, so fuel permeability at the ring is 100% instead of 1.7%, core fuel drops to 0.34-0.35 (the claim's no-ring level) and persistent splits to 8 and 4. With the rod-only rate raised 3.7x to match total production the ring gates partly (core fuel 0.48) but splits stay at 8 (seed 5). At 1.5x resolution (dx 2/3, 192^2) nothing nucleates with the per-pixel noise unchanged; with the noise scaled to the same power per area, rods, gating rings and division hold (12 and 11 persistent splits, gen 3, band s 0.63).

verdicts.limitation: B is by construction under the RUBRIC rule (the medium makes most of the layer species, placed by a drift written against phi): a self-made ring exists but stays far below the gate and does no work, so the claimed work of the ring is done by bath-made surfactant. The linear twin (author's, not re-run by me) loses bodies, so it supports I and D beyond diffusion only trivially (no phase separation) and says nothing about the active stress or the ring. Nucleation from noise depends on per-pixel noise amplitude at 1.5x. The matched-rate rod-only arm is one seed. ringstat's pixel bands were not rescaled at 1.5x.
